note: An <if condition> element in the config is compiled with Janino. IfModelHandler.handle does it from 1.3 (present in 1.3.11, 1.4.11 and 1.5.12); before that IfAction.begin (present in 1.1.0 and 1.2.12, gone from 1.3). Needs a writable config file or a planted environment variable. Logback builds its configuration from logback.xml, element by element and class by class name, so no sink reached proves nothing.
